title: Settings boxes duplicate their open state in a bool next to the dialog registry
trigger: Settings > Account > Log out; Settings > Stickers manager.
effect: log_out_confirm and sticker_settings_open are bools set beside open_box(DialogKind::..) and cleared by hand in several places (log_out.rs three sites, settings_window/mod.rs:160, stickers_manager/mod.rs); archive and the mask/emoji boxes keep their flag in the Session and need the Farewell to close them.
fix: One open-state per box in the dialog registry (DialogKind is the stage), no mirrored bool in SettingsUi.

title: Keybinding capture and its error, and the system accent with its probed flag, are separate fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Settings > Appearance > Shortcuts: start a capture, hit a conflict, change account.
effect: keybinding_capture: Option<String> and keybinding_error: Option<(String,String)> must be cleared together (done by hand in invalidate_account_keybindings and in 3 UI sites); system_accent: Option<u32> + system_accent_probed: bool is Unprobed/Probed(Option); keybindings_applied is a 'started' bool.
fix: enum Capture { Idle, Waiting(action), Refused{action,message} }; enum SystemAccent { Unread, Read(Option<u32>) }.

title: Arrival stage is landed Option<Instant>, centered_at Option and a shared row Cell kept in step by hand
trigger: Search result opens a page: seeking the row, centered, washing, finished.
effect: No bug today beyond 13-TMP-015; the stage is spread over three fields plus the owner's Option<Arrival>.
fix: enum Arrival { Seeking { target, row }, Washing { target, row, landed, centered_at } } with the finish being the owner dropping it.

title: Log out box open state is settings.log_out_confirm bool, second to account_boxes.lifecycle.confirm_logout
trigger: Settings > Account > Log out, and the Account dialog's own logout confirmation.
effect: Two confirm flags for one action, each cleared by hand; submit_logout clears only the lifecycle one.
fix: One enum LogOutBox { Closed, Asking(Origin) } owned by the settings window or the account box, not both.

title: Archive settings: archive_settings_loading bool beside an Option of the loaded value, and an open flag in the Session
trigger: Settings > Privacy > Archive and Mute, or the archive settings box, with a failing request.
effect: archive_settings_loading: bool + archive_chat_list_settings: Option<_> are Fetch<T> by hand (cleared in apply.rs:217 and error.rs:138, set in connect/chat_list/mod.rs:402 only when the Option is None); archive_settings_open lives in the Session and needs SettingsUi's Farewell to close it.
fix: Fetch<ArchiveChatListSettings> in the chat-list state; the box's open flag in the UI dialog registry.

title: Reset-token confirmation is a bool set beside open_box and cleared by hand
trigger: Settings > Agent access > Reset token.
effect: agent_ui.page.reset_confirm duplicates DialogKind::AgentResetToken; confirm_agent_token_reset clears it, other closers must as well; the early return on refuse_if_injecting leaves it set.
fix: Let the dialog registry be the only open state; no mirrored bool.

title: Agent page keeps reset_confirm bool (dialog open flag), picker with picker_key, focus_chat and scroll_to as parallel fields
trigger: Reset the agent token box, the chat menus' Agent access, Add a chat picker.
effect: reset_confirm is cleared by hand in three places in agent_dialogs.rs; picker and picker_key must change together (both reset in two places); focus_chat is only valid for the active account (checked per render).
fix: enum AgentDialog { None, ResetToken } for the box; picker: Option<(PickerKey, ChatPicker)> as one value; focus_chat: Option<AccountChat>.

title: SettingsSearch keeps query text, selected index and pending_clear flag beside the input entity's own value
trigger: Typing, Enter on a result, Esc, closing Settings.
effect: query mirrors the input value on each Change and is reset by hand in clear_settings_search and focus_settings_search; pending_clear is a one-shot 'clear on next render' stage flag.
fix: Read the query from the input entity (single source) and model the field as enum Search { Idle, Typing{selected}, ClearOnNextRender } or clear immediately where a window is at hand.

title: ShareUi stages as flags and Options: focus_search, link_text, forward_result, content_dialog.focus_on_mount
trigger: Forward box opens (focus_search set, taken by whichever box mounts first), share-link chooser, forward result bar, contact chooser.
effect: focus_search is a one-shot 'just opened' flag consumed by two different boxes (forward_box, reply_elsewhere_box) and left set if the box never mounts (locked, hidden), so a later box takes focus unasked; focus_on_mount is the same shape.
fix: Put the 'focus on mount' stage inside the box's own enum (Mounting -> Shown) so the box that owns it consumes it, and give link_text and forward_result an owner enum with a way out on lock and chat change.

title: Calls and Contacts tabs are two bools set against each other
trigger: demo_showcase_calls and demo_showcase_contacts set calls_tab_open and contacts_tab_open and clear the other by hand (same pair as the chat list's real tab handlers).
effect: No bug in the demo; both true would draw two tabs.
fix: A ChatListTab enum (Chats, Calls, Contacts).

title: SidebarReveal holds hidden, two glides and a pointer enum that must agree
trigger: set_hidden, pointer_entered, pointer_left, dismiss and settle each move several of hidden, docked, peek and pointer; the glide target must equal hidden.
effect: No bug found; the tests cover the transitions.
fix: Derive the glide targets from one SidebarMode enum (Docked, Hidden{peek: Peek}).

title: SignInUi keeps the sign-in stage as bools and strings in step by hand
trigger: picker_open, editing_phone, touched, banned_dismissed, tick_armed, hint, phone_text and submitted_phone are set from sync_signin, submit_phone, signin_error and button handlers; tick_armed is set before spawn_screen and cleared only by the continuation.
effect: No bug today; a dropped tick or a missed reset would stick the countdown or the phone form.
fix: One SignInStep enum (Phone, PhoneSending, Code, EditingPhone, ...) plus a Ticker handle as Option<Task> that is its own armed state.

title: Three Option<(state, Instant)> clocks mirror the auth state and are re-armed by hand
trigger: sync_signin resets code_clock and email_clock when the delivery or reset value differs and clears them off-step; signin_error resets error_clock and banned_dismissed on a changed or absent error; submit_phone clears code_clock, error_clock, banned_dismissed.
effect: No bug today; any new auth transition that skips one of the places leaves a stale countdown.
fix: Store the clock inside the auth step enum variant that owns it, so leaving the step drops it.

title: ComposerSpelling keeps misspellings, checked_text and a task in step
trigger: sync_spellcheck, schedule_spellcheck, spellcheck_now, recheck_spelling and install_spell_engine each rewrite checked_text, misspellings and task; a result is applied only if checked_text still equals the text it checked.
effect: No bug found.
fix: SpellState enum (Off, Checked{text, misspellings}, Checking{text, task, previous}).

title: The Forward-to chooser's open state is 'choosing is non-empty' next to a search field reset by hand
trigger: Files arrive from outside; begin/close/choose each clear choosing and search separately.
effect: Dialog is_open, the search text and the file list must be kept in step in close_start_files and choose_start_files_chat.
fix: enum StartFiles { Idle, Choosing{files, search} }.

title: GPU-loss recovery is recovered: Cell<bool> + kept: RefCell<Option<KeptWindow>> + gpu_gone read from the platform
trigger: Window closes after a GPU or renderer loss.
effect: 'recovered' is set before the reopen succeeds and never reset, so any second renderer loss in the whole process life quits the app even days after a good recovery; kept must be taken in step with the step chosen.
fix: enum Recovery { Healthy, Recovering, Recovered{at} } with a reset after a successful reopen.

title: ZoomedDay is chart: Option + error: Option, both None meaning 'loading'
trigger: Zoom into a day; GraphFetch Loading/Loaded/Failed is mapped to two Options in stat_graph_section.
effect: Loading and failed-to-parse are told apart only by which Option is set.
fix: ZoomedDay { x, fetch: Fetch<Rc<StatChart>> }.

title: range/_range_changes and pie/_pie_changes are Option pairs kept in step by hand
trigger: sync(), reset_range(), enter_pie() and exit_pie() set and clear the Option and its Subscription separately.
effect: A subscription can outlive or miss its slider if one site forgets the pair.
fix: Put the Subscription inside RangeSelector/PieZoom so they drop together.

title: Public shares list is loading: bool + error: Option + next_offset + list passed as separate arguments
trigger: Message page: forwards.loading/forwards.error; story page: forwards_loading/forwards_error.
effect: Both loading and an error line can show; 'Show more' hides while loading.
fix: Fetch<Page> per list with next_offset inside the ready variant.

title: Player and UiClip keep stage as Cell<bool>/Option/bool combinations
trigger: Any sticker shown
effect: pump and closer are 'task started' bools reset by hand; UiClip.timeline + failed + ready_at + shown mirror the engine's ClipState (Opening/Ready/Failed) and failed is sticky until the clip closes
fix: UiClip::state enum {Opening, Ready{timeline}, Failed}; closer/pump as Option<Task> handles

title: The set box's editing flow is spread over create, encoding, pick, pending_still, pending_video and four modal bools
trigger: Any create/adapt/rename/delete flow
effect: Stages (choosing, decoding still, downloading video, editing, naming emojis, encoding) are Options and bools reset by hand in reset(); reordering, rename_open, delete_set_open, remove_set_open and delete_sticker can be set together
fix: One enum SetEdit {Idle, Reordering, Renaming, ConfirmDeleteSticker(item), ConfirmDeleteSet, ConfirmRemoveSet, Picking(pick), DecodingStill(..), DownloadingVideo(..), Naming(create), Encoding{create,cancel}}

title: ManagerView.loading and failed are copies of session flags (installed_loaded, requests.has_purpose, panel.failed)
trigger: Open the manager and switch tabs
effect: Loading is derived from three sources by hand per tab; failed is one bool shared by all tabs (a failed Trending page shows 'could not update' on Installed)
fix: Per-tab Fetch<Vec<StickerSetInfo>> in the panel state

title: greeting_loaded is set when the request is sent, not when answered
trigger: Open an empty private chat once while offline or the request fails
effect: The flag means 'requested'; a failure is never retried this session so the greeting never shows, and the UI cannot tell loading from loaded
fix: Fetch<Vec<StickerItem>> for greeting with a retry on reconnect

title: The picker status line is built from loading_tab, loading_set, failed and search_has_more
trigger: Sticker panel in any tab
effect: failed is one bool for every tab and loading_set a second flag beside request purposes; an error in one tab shows in all and can sit beside loading
fix: Per-tab Fetch<T>

title: Strip pull state is spread over strip.pull (expanded/revealing), strip.context Option as 'settled' token and the shared bounce Cell
trigger: pull the chat list down, change folder, open a chat while expanded
effect: expanded/collapsed/revealing decided in render by comparing a stored PullContext and mutating the list's scroll offset in step
fix: enum StripState { Collapsed, Revealing{since}, Expanded } with the context part of the Expanded variant

title: CoverPicker stage is duration_ms Option + unreadable bool + preview_job Option + dragging bool, plus cover_sent bool in StoryViewerUi
trigger: open the cover picker on a video story
effect: Loading/ready/unreadable and the save stage are separate fields kept in step by hand
fix: enum CoverStage { Probing, Ready{duration_ms}, Unreadable } and enum CoverSave { Idle, Sent(RequestId) } owned by the picker

title: Privacy editor stage is privacy_edit Option + privacy_sent bool matched against the global manage slot
trigger: edit a story's privacy and Save
effect: privacy_sent is cleared by frame_upkeep when manage.pending is false, not by the answer to this call
fix: PrivacyStage { Editing, Saving(RequestId) }

title: StoryComposer stage is open bool + check_sent + post_sent + save_sent + local_error + edit_target/repost_source modes
trigger: post, repost or edit a story
effect: checking, posting and saving are three bools plus an error string reconciled by story_frame_upkeep against session.stories.post and manage.pending
fix: enum ComposerStage { Editing{error}, Checking(RequestId), Posting(RequestId), Saving(RequestId), Posted } and enum ComposerMode { New, Repost(src), Edit(target) }

title: StoryPage view is open_album Option + picker Option + delete_confirm Option kept in step by hand
trigger: use the chat story page
effect: album list, opened album, picker and the armed delete are separate fields; the picker can be Some with open_album None or Some
fix: enum StoryPageView { Albums, Album{id, delete_armed}, Picker{target} }

title: Live story state carries extras_requested bool (set by hand in the demo seed)
trigger: n/a
effect: A request-sent flag on the session's live story state that the demo sets directly; a real failed request cannot clear it.
fix: Fetch<T> for donors/levels extras instead of a requested bool.

title: Stars box flow is stars_box Option + then_send bool + stars_before_top_up Option + chosen_stars, reset together in reset()
trigger: n/a
effect: Several fields that must change together across box, top-up and send; see 13-TMP-004.
fix: One enum StarsFlow for the box and the top-up round trip; chosen_stars stays the composer's value.

title: Live join stage is `watching: Option` + `seen_call: bool` (+ the session's story_stream and pending join) kept in step by hand
trigger: n/a
effect: seen_call gives 'call was tracked' meaning to a missing story_stream; retry_live_story resets it by hand; join failure is not representable (see 13-TMP-001).
fix: enum LiveWatch { None, Joining(story), Joined(story), Failed(story) }.

title: Reply row is reply_open + reply_panel bools beside the shared media panel and the recorder purpose
trigger: n/a
effect: toggle_live_emoji sets reply_open=true, opens the panel, then resets reply_open by hand if the panel is not active; end_story_reply clears both bools separately; story_reply_panel_active needs reply_open && reply_panel && media_panel.is_open() agreeing. reply_panel stays true after the panel is closed elsewhere.
fix: enum ReplyRow { Closed, Typing, Panel(tab), Recording } on StoryViewerUi; the media panel reads it.

title: Suggested-post boxes are five Options that must follow the flow by hand
trigger: Price box -> time box -> accept box; Accept needs a time box first, balance shortfall opens grams_needed while price stays open.
effect: price, time, accept, decline, grams_needed are independent Options; ordering (time above price, grams_needed above price) and clears (confirm_suggest_accept clears accept before ask_for_balance; submit_suggest_time clears time then price.send_date) are done at each call site.
fix: One enum SuggestFlow { Price{..}, PriceTime{price,time}, PriceGrams{..}, Accept, AcceptTime, Decline } with explicit transitions.

title: SuggestBar mode and edit_of are two fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Edit Message from the Suggest Changes menu, then open the bar's price box and apply terms.
effect: begin_suggest_edit sets mode=Change and edit_of=Some together; apply_suggest_terms re-reads edit_of from the old bar and takes mode from the box; composer_post_options and set_suggest_bar both branch on edit_of.is_none() separately. No bug today, but nothing ties the two.
fix: enum SuggestBarKind { New, Counter, EditOf(MessageId) } carrying the message id only in the edit variant.

title: SyntheticKind::Image carries a loaded bool stage
trigger: Pre-login synthetic chat: photo row placeholder loads after a 900 ms timer.
effect: Image{loaded:bool} is a loading/loaded stage matched in three places (finish_image, message_bubble_with_quote height and label); demo only.
fix: SyntheticKind::{ImageLoading, ImageLoaded}.

title: hovered bool and Showing.running_since are the same stage in two places
trigger: Hover, dismiss, push, window_closed.
effect: hovered says whether the next toast starts paused; running_since says whether the visible one runs. They are updated in step in set_hovered, dismiss, show and window_closed.
fix: enum Timer { Running{since}, Paused{left} } on Showing plus a single Pointer state on the queue.

title: Money page view is derived from five flags and options
trigger: Open Money, open a transfer, open an NFT, dismiss the first-grams hint.
effect: hint_open, selected_tx, selected_nft, tx_loading, tx_error decide the body by if/else order; show_wallet_transaction, select_wallet_nft and money_back each clear a different subset by hand. history/nfts each also have loading+loaded+error triples.
fix: enum MoneyView { Overview, TxLoading(id), TxFailed(id,msg), Tx(tx), Nft(addr), FirstGrams } and Fetch<T> for the lists.

title: Touch Bar picker fill uses filled bool plus pending Option
trigger: Tap the sticker/emoji segment after the lists change; switch accounts.
effect: filled (ever filled) and pending (latest lists) are managed by offer_picker / fill_pending_picker; after an account switch the scrubbers keep the previous account's stickers until the next tap because only pending is replaced.
fix: enum PickerFill { Empty, Shown(lists), Shown+Waiting(lists,next) } and clear it on the account/lock change.

title: Sync throttle is a `pending: Cell<bool>` flag
trigger: Any app notify while a sync task is scheduled.
effect: No bug today (cleared before the update, cleared even when the window update fails), but it is a stage flag kept next to HOST.is_some() and enabled(): idle / scheduled.
fix: enum SyncStage { Idle, Scheduled(Task<()>) } holding the task, so dropping the owner cancels it.

title: Pinned panel gesture and animation stages are bools/Options kept in step
trigger: Press, drag, drop, cancel, order change while dragging, online dot animation.
effect: Drag{started: bool} inside Option<Drag> is Idle/Pressed/Dragging; ivars.timer Option<NSTimer> is an 'animating' flag next to Slide.started Option<Instant> in every entry; set_pins clears touch by hand when the order changes. If the timer block cannot borrow the slot (try_borrow_mut fails) the timer is invalidated but the slot stays Some, and animate_if_needed then never starts another (animations frozen).
fix: enum Gesture { Idle, Pressed, Dragging } and enum Animation { Still, Running(Retained<NSTimer>) } owned by the panel; one transition function for each.

title: TranslateDialog modes are view + Option source + Option job + close_after_choose by hand
trigger: Open Translate from a message, the selection, the bar menu (chooser) or Settings (skip list); switch language, go back, close.
effect: No stuck state found, but the mode is spread over four fields: back_to_box is recomputed as `view==ChooseTo && source.is_some()`, close_after_choose is only meaningful for a ChooseTo with no source, and job is only meaningful for Selection. Each close path must remember to drop the job.
fix: enum TranslateDialog { Translating{source, to, job, expanded}, Choosing{back: Option<Translating>}, SkipList } so each variant carries only its data.
